items.title: huangruiteng/loopx
items.description: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams. Agent-loop agnostic across Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents, with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs, and verifiable handoffs.

It provides durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, and executable state, and it's agent-loop agnostic, so it works with Codex, Claude Code, and similar coding agents. Useful if you need multi-turn agent workflows to persist reliably.

items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud has released TencentDB-Agent-Memory, a team-level memory hub for AI agents. It converts conversations, documents, and code into four reusable assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph. The project focuses on governed, shared memory, making it useful for developers building multi-agent systems that need consistent context and tool knowledge across sessions.

items.summary_en: firecrawl/pdf-inspector is a fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction, with automatic detection of scanned versus text-based PDFs for smarter routing. It suits developers building high-throughput document pipelines. Trending on GitHub today.

items.title: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
items.description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a terminal-based AI coding agent built natively for DeepSeek models. It's engineered around prefix-cache stability, so it can be left running for long-lived sessions. Developers who use DeepSeek heavily will benefit from fewer redundant context loads and smoother continuous interactions.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
items.author: addyosmani
items.summary_zh: agent-skills 是 Google Chrome 团队 Addy Osmani 发起的开源项目，旨在为AI编码代理注入生产级的工程技能。项目提供了一套精心设计的技能库，涵盖代码审查、调试、测试生成、性能优化、安全审计等专业领域。每个技能以清晰的提示（prompt）和示例形式呈现，使AI代理能像资深工程师一样思考和工作。该项目的重要性在于填补了当前AI编码助手的核心短板——多数工具只能生成代码片段，但缺乏对代码质量、可维护性和工程规范的深层次理解。受益对象是所有使用AI辅助编程的开发者，尤其是团队中的高级工程师和架构师。GitHub趋势榜上的高关注度反映了开发者对“更有用AI代理”的迫切需求。项目本身是纯文本/知识库形式，依赖LLM本身的推理能力，不绑定特定平台，因此极易集成到Cline、GitHub Copilot等工具中。
items.summary_en: Agent-skills is an open-source project by Google Chrome's Addy Osmani that equips AI coding agents with production-grade engineering competencies. It provides a curated library of skills—code review, debugging, test generation, performance optimization, and security auditing—each packaged as well-crafted prompts with real-world examples. The project addresses a critical gap in current AI coding assistants: most can generate code but lack deep understanding of quality, maintainability, and engineering best practices. Senior developers, teams adopting AI-assisted workflows, and tool builders benefit directly from these reusable skill definitions. Its rapid rise on GitHub signals urgent demand for more capable, context-aware AI agents. The project is platform-agnostic (pure text/prompt libraries) and integrates easily with agents like Cline, Claude Code, or Copilot. By codifying expert knowledge into prompt templates, it pushes AI coding from toy examples toward production readiness.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.author: obra
items.summary_zh: Superpowers 是一套面向 AI 代理的“技能框架”和软件开发方法论。它试图解决当前大模型在复杂任务中缺乏结构化思考的问题——通过定义清晰的技能单元和协作流程，让 AI 代理像人类工程师一样分步解决问题。这个框架不仅给 AI 用，也可以指导人类团队如何拆解需求、编写代码、进行测试。如果你在探索如何让 AI 更可靠地参与实际项目开发，或者想建立更高效的工程协作流程，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology designed to make AI agents work more reliably on complex engineering tasks. Instead of letting a model guess its way through a problem, it decomposes work into defined skills, checks, and iterative steps—similar to how a senior engineer would approach a feature. The framework is practical enough to be used by human teams as well. If you're building AI-powered coding tools or want to inject disciplined structure into your development workflow, this project offers a fresh, actionable approach.

items.title: tailwindlabs/tailwindcss

items.author: tailwindlabs

items.summary_en: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development. It provides low-level utility classes that developers combine directly in HTML to handle spacing, color, and layout, reducing the need for custom CSS and context-switching. This makes it easier to build and adjust interfaces quickly, especially in component-based front-end projects.

items.summary_en: ADR is Uber's security framework for enterprise AI agents, combining observability, security benchmarking, and threat detection; it's already deployed at Uber. It helps teams evaluate safety before rollout and monitor for anomalies during runtime. This matters for platform and security teams running AI agents in production.

items.summary_en: BitChat is an open-source chat application built on Bluetooth Mesh, allowing devices to automatically form a network and exchange messages without any internet or central server. items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway that exposes a single endpoint to access over 290 providers (90+ free) and 500+ models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, and many more. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

digest_items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
digest_items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
digest_items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
digest_items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

digest_items.description: 先说结论。 从设计稿到能在浏览器里打开、点击充电桩弹出状态面板的 3D 可视化大屏，我没有写任何一行代码，没有在 Blender 里手动拖过一次控件，也没有切过一张图。 整条链路交给了 ChatGPT
digest_items.summary_zh: 作者分享了自己用 ChatGPT 5.6（代号 Sol）从零构建智慧充电站 3D 可视化大屏的体验。整个过程没写一行代码，没碰任何设计软件——设计师只需给出草图，AI 就能生成可在浏览器中交互的 3D 场景，点击充电桩还会弹出状态面板。这展示了大模型在 UI 生成和 3D 场景构建上的惊人能力，尤其适合不擅长编码的产品经理或设计师，让他们快速验证创意。
digest_items.summary_en: The author recounts building a 3D smart charging station dashboard using ChatGPT 5.6 (codenamed Sol) without writing a single line of code. Starting from hand-drawn sketches, the AI generated an interactive 3D scene with clickable charging piles and status panels, all running in a browser. This demonstrates how large language models are lowering the barrier for non-programmers—especially product managers and designers—to prototype and visualize complex interactive experiences quickly.
